text:
44세 남환, severe pulmonary embolism으로 입원함.

BP 90/60 mmHg
HR 125 bpm
RR 28 breaths/min
BT 37.2°C
SpO2 86% on room air

Severe chest pain 호소함.

Heparin 5000 units IV q4h 적용함.

High-flow nasal cannula 적용함.

C-line 유지함.

Negative fluid balance 확인됨.

Drowsy 상태 확인됨.

담당의 notify함: decreased SpO2, tachycardia.
